articleTitle: Cross-Domain Deterministic Communication System for Differentiated Concurrent Services Based on Intelligent Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Under the background of the “dual carbon” goal and related policies and the construction of new power systems, the large-scale deployment of sensing terminals and the explosive growth of the perception amount of data in the distribution system, the low transmission efficiency of the traditional distribution network has been unable to meet the needs of “comprehensive perception and efficient collaboration”. How to achieve rapid transmission and real-time analysis of massive sensing data has become one of the main challenges of the new distribution network. Adding lossless compression to edge computing provides a way to transmit lightweight data at cloud edge. Considering the QoS requirements of differentiated concurrent services, this paper proposes an intelligent compressed cross-domain deterministic communication system for differentiated concurrent services. First, a cross-domain deterministic communication system model for differentiated concurrent services is constructed. The problem is optimized according to service QoS requirements and model constraints, and the service compression ratio is minimized under the condition that the service requirements are met. Then deep reinforcement learning method is used to solve the problem, and finally the proposed system effectively improves the certainty of massive distributed PV through simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Garbage Image Classification Model Based on DenseNet121 and Its Application in Robotic Arm Sorting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Classifying and processing garbage can not only collect recyclable waste and turn it into treasure, but also relieve environmental pressure. In view of the high cost and low efficiency of traditional manual sorting methods, which cannot meet the needs of a large amount of garbage disposal, this paper is based on the lightweight neural network DenseNet121, introduces the CBAM attention mechanism, and explores the influence of the position and number of CBAM attention added in the DenseNet121 network on network performance, obtains the optimal combination, adds transfer learning, and proposes the S_E_CBAM_DenseNet121 model. Experimental results show that the average accuracy of the algorithm on the self-built data set is 96.53%, which is 1.67%, 2.99%, 3.27%, 1.97%, and 2.36% higher than that of the original model, MobileNet, Xception, InceptionV3, and ResNet50 models respectively. At the same time, this model is used for the actual deployment of the robotic arm and achieves good sorting results, verifying the effectiveness of the network model proposed in this paper. It not only has important engineering reference value but also has good academic value.

articleTitle: Capturing Complex Spatial-Temporal Dependencies in Traffic Forecasting: A Self-Attention Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: We study the problem of traffic forecasting, aiming to predict the inflow and outflow of a region in the subsequent time slot. The problem is complex due to the intricate spatial and temporal interdependence among regions. Prior works study the spatial and temporal dependency in a decouple manner, failing to capture their joint effect. In this work, we propose ST-SAM, a novel and efficient Spatial-Temporal Self-Attention Model for traffic forecasting. ST-SAM uses a region embedding layer to learn time-specific embedding from traffic data for regions. Then, it employs a spatial-temporal dependency learning module based on self-attention mechanism to capture the joint spatial-temporal dependency for both nearby and faraway regions. ST-SAM entirely relies on self-attention to capture both local and global spatial-temporal correlations, which make it effective and efficient. Extensive experiments on two real world datasets show that ST-SAM is substantially more accurate and efficient than the state-of-the-art approaches (with an average improvement of up to 15% on RMSE, 17% on MAPE, and 32 times on training time in our experiments).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Marine Engine Room Monitoring and Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper designs and realizes a marine engine room monitoring and alarm system based on the controller of Siemens PLC, introduces the design means and the practice process in detail, optimizes the system structure then uses the Profinet, carried out the monitor alarm system's each function with the monitoring and communication program which uses the PLC's trapezoidal chart language And with the Visual Studio 2022 as the developing platform, carried out the program in the position machine with the C# programming language. The system has been used in the experimental teaching, scientific research and real ship, and the results show that the system has the merits of better stability, stronger extension, better effect and so on.

articleTitle: Crowd Counting Algorithm for Train Carriages Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to monitor the crowded condition in the carriages and provide accurate data support for urban rail transportation, This study presents a crowd counting approach based on convolutional neural networks for train carriages. The algorithm is based on part of the structure of the VGG-16 network for the initial extraction of passenger features. Through the multi-level information aggregation module, it realizes the enhancement of perception and extraction ability of passenger features at different scales. And by constructing the multi-attention collaboration module, the network pays more attention to the human head region and reduces the interference of background objects. The experimental findings indicate that the proposed algorithm attains a mean absolute error of 1.5 and a mean square error of 2.1, respectively, in the urban rail transit train compartment scenario, suggesting that the proposed algorithm demonstrates high accuracy.

articleTitle: Experiment Study of Passive Radar Maritime Target Detection Based on Staring Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduces the characteristics of passive radar system and staring radar as well as briefly introduces the data processing method, uses gaze radar as a non-cooperative radiation source, carries out a series of maritime target detection experiments, and verifies the experimental results with AIS system. The results show that the passive radar system can accurately get the target speed, distance and other information.

articleTitle: Design of Electromagnetic Tracing Intelligent Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of the times and the progress of technology, people's travel methods are becoming more and more convenient, and intelligent driverless cars have also entered our field of vision. However, during the driving process of a car, many unstable phenomena such as deviation are inevitable. To enable the car to maintain a stable trajectory on the track while in motion, electromagnetic signals were collected for guidance. Design an intelligent car controlled by a microcontroller that automatically drives by collecting electromagnetic signals. The car uses a gyroscope and TOF infrared ranging module to recognize track elements and make responsive reactions. By testing its speed and stability on the track, the vehicle exhibited significant performance in high-speed trajectory tracking on the electromagnetic track. If it could be applied in future autonomous vehicles' operation, it would greatly enhance the safety and reliability of smart car operations.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Explosion Hearing Damage Assessment Based on AHAAH Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: During the explosion process of a certain type of explosive, shock waves and pulse noise can cause damage to the hearing system. COMSOL software was used for simulation to convert shock waves into sound pressure values and thereby construct the sound field when the explosive explodes. The characteristics and laws of the strong sound generated by the explosive in the air were calculated. The hearing damage model (AHAAH) software was used to evaluate the hearing damage risk value ARU at different measurement points from the explosion center, so as to determine the hearing damage situation at different positions from the core explosion, providing data support for the safe hearing distance during the explosion.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Analysis for PMSM Servo System Based on Dynamic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To improve the analyzing efficiency for PMSM servo system considering the dynamic parameters of the insulated-gate bipolar transistor, in this work, a novel approach of an artificial intelligence computational framework for system-level simulation project is proposed. An instance is investigated subsequently, meanwhile, the accuracy of the approach with five machine learning methods is compared. The time consumption and error in test sets prove the high efficiency of the approach to analyze the speed of permanent magnet synchronous motor. This work is helpful for the massive numerical analysis in the design process of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficiency Evaluation of Air Control Tasks in Collaborative Formations of Manned/Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The evaluation method for the collaborative combat effectiveness of manned/unmanned aerial vehicles mainly relies on analytical methods to quickly obtain evaluation results. This method mostly evaluates indicators based on expert experience or relies on the tactical indicators of the combat platform for calculation, making it difficult to ensure accuracy in complex and changing battlefield environments. The study first starts from the perspective of operational task requirements, constructs a combat effectiveness evaluation index system, and quantifies the indicators. Construct a combat effectiveness evaluation model based on grey clustering, combined with simulation scenarios of coordinated formation air control tasks of manned and unmanned aerial vehicles, establish an evaluation index system for combat effectiveness of air control tasks, collect and process simulation experimental data, and conduct effective combat effectiveness evaluation analysis.

articleTitle: A New Design of Multi-Channel Phase Comparator Based on Mixed Double Mixing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Accurate time plays an important role in deep space exploration, navigation and positioning. With the development of technology, both the performance requirements of the punctual system and the accuracy of the metering equipment have been greatly improved, and the demand for high-precision phase comparators has become higher. This work presents a design of multi-channel phase comparator, which adopts the double mixing time difference method of digital and analog, and effectively counteracts the interference of noise and other factors through symmetrical structure. By FPGA processing, the phase difference data of each channel can be sent in real time, which can be used to judge the performance of each atomic clock in the timekeeping system and optimize the timekeeping system. We conclude that the method reduces the additional frequency stability of the phase comparator can reach 1.2E-14/s,1.OE-17/1d, which can meet the needs of the current timekeeping system and metrological work.

articleTitle: Double-scale Convolutional Neural Network with Attention Mechanism for Track Circuit Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As one of the important equipment of railway signaling system, ZPW-2000 track circuit is prone to failure due to environmental impact. Once a failure occurs, it will directly affect the safety of train operation. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of track circuit fault detection, this paper proposes a track circuit fault detection method based on double-scale convolutional neural network (DSCNN) with self-attention (SA) mechanism and squeeze-excitation (SE) attention mechanism. Firstly, the SA mechanism is introduced to extract the global information of the track circuit data. Secondly, DSCNN with different convolution scales are used to extract multiple features from the data. Finally, the SE attention mechanism is introduced to focus on different channel features and improve the performance of the model. The experimental results show that the proposed method can realize the fault detection of track circuit, and the detection accuracy is 99%.

articleTitle: An FTN Sequence Detection Algorithm Based on Soft Information Iteration and ADMM Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the severe inter-symbol interference (ISI) problem in faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) communication systems, this paper proposes an Iterative Soft ADMM Detection (ISAD) sequence detection algorithm. The ISAD algorithm ingeniously integrates soft information iterative updating with ADMM optimization by alternately estimating residual ISI and updating symbol soft values while utilizing constellation prior knowledge and observation information to guide symbol estimation, ultimately achieving efficient detection in FTN systems. Compared with traditional methods, the ISAD algorithm effectively suppresses ISI while significantly reducing computational complexity, particularly in medium to high-order modulation schemes, where it exhibits outstanding performance. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can effectively suppress ISI in medium to high-order modulation and achieve bit error rate performance close to that of Nyquist orthogonal transmission. The proposed ADMM soft detection algorithm provides an effective solution for FTN communication systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Problem-Solving Abilities with Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The problem-solving abilities of large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced in various fields, yet their potential for tackling complex tasks remains underexplored. This paper introduces a novel framework that enhances LLM performance by incorporating reinforcement learning (RL). By combining a policy model, which generates candidate solutions, and a reward model, which evaluates their accuracy, our approach creates a feedback loop that systematically improves the model's solution-generation capabilities. Tested across challenging datasets, our framework achieves superior performance compared to traditional models, highlighting the potential of LLMs augmented with RL to solve complex tasks more effectively. This research provides a robust foundation for advancing automated problem-solving systems.

articleTitle: Learning to Beamform for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Assisted Dual-Functional Radar-Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of designing joint transmit and receive beamforming for dual-function radar-communication (DFRC) systems. The system model under consideration involves multiple communication users and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). An optimization problem is formulated to maximizing the achievable sum rate for communication user and Base Station (BS) receiver while satisfying transmit and receive beamforming constant modulus constraints. This represents a standard nonconvex optimization problem. To solve it, we introduce an online learning approach by configuring adjustable network parameters and creating the concerned loss function. Simulation results show that the proposed learning algorithm achieves a higher achievable sum rate for communication user and BS receiver compared to existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Cooperative UAV Maneuver Decision-Making Based on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we design a cooperative UAV maneuver decision-making task and use multi-agent reinforcement learning to solve it. In this task, two UAVs must learn cooperating with each other to defeat a stronger enemy. Due to sparse reward signal and insufficient exploration, the agents will learn a suboptimal policy. To mitigate this effect, the weighted entropy of reward is maximized to encouraged agent to explore while the expected cumulative reward is maximized. The weighted entropy of reward as an additional objective can be also optimized with reinforcement learning where the additional reward function is negatively correlated with the frequency of the reward obtained by agent. The test results show that compared with Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), MAPPO with maximizing the weighted reward entropy has better performance.

articleTitle: A Multi-Scale Dilated Causal Convolution Network Based on Data Decomposition for the Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of rolling bearings is crucial for optimizing production and maintenance management and reducing production costs. However, RUL prediction in the presence of intense background noise is challenging. Due to the non-stationarity and complex degradation characteristics of vibration signals, extracting critical features becomes difficult, affecting the accuracy of the prediction. This paper proposes a novel RUL prediction framework DEC-MSTCN, which combining hybrid features and multi-scale temporal convolution networks (TCN) to address the noise issue and extract more stationary-bearing data. Specifically, we use the fast Fourier transform to analyze the stability of the bearing data in the frequency domain and reduce the impact of noise through adaptive parameters. In addition, the multi-scale temporal-spatial convolution network can learn rich multi-scale low-noise features from limited data, thereby improving the accuracy of RUL prediction. We verified the performance of the proposed method using real bearing data and compared it with commonly used prediction methods. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Setup and Analysis of the X-Ray Free-Electron Lasers (XFELs) Experiment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The development of XFELs has revolutionized the biological structure field by allowing for the collection of high-resolution structures from very small crystals with minimal radiation damage. While the XFELs experiments pose several unique challenges. The linear DNA from salmon sperm were scattered by XFELs in Spring8 and millions of scattering patterns were obtained in our experiment. Then, the sum of scattering intensity divided by the photo diodes in the range of q (0~0.2 Å) was calculated. Finally, the results of the peg with linear DNA were calculated separately from the different experiment setup.

articleTitle: Implementation of Deterministic Latency at the Receiver of JESD204C
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the emergence and advancement of various new information technologies, there has been a sharp increase in data traffic between devices. JESD204C is a protocol tailored to handle higher data rates. This paper, grounded in the JESD204C standard, elucidates the principle of deterministic latency, one of the protocol's core characteristics. It also presents a circuit designed to identify and correct errors that could lead to misalignment by one Local Extended Multiblock Clock (LEMC) in multi-channel data. Furthermore, the paper ensures the robustness of deterministic latency upon multiple power-up instances.

articleTitle: Experimental Design of AC Loss Measurement for Superconductors Using Pulse Current Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper aims to study and design an experiment based on the Pulse Current Method (PCM) for measuring the AC loss of superconductors. This method overcomes the limitations of traditional measurement techniques, particularly improving the accuracy of loss measurement in superconducting materials under low-temperature conditions. In the experiment, the PCM was used to measure the AC loss in both the conductor layer and the shielding layer of superconducting cable samples. The results show that the AC loss measured from the conductor layer using PCM is significantly lower than that measured using traditional methods, demonstrating the efficiency and accuracy of PCM in measuring AC loss across different superconducting materials.

articleTitle: An E-Commerce Precision Marketing Optimization Method Based on Graph Neural Network and Social Media Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, precision marketing has become a key strategy to enhance enterprise competitiveness and user satisfaction. However, the diversity and complexity of user behavioral data and the rich emotional information on social media make precision marketing face many challenges. In this paper, we propose an integrated approach based on Graph Attention Network (GAT) and Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HGNN), aiming to realize more accurate and personalized marketing strategy optimization by deeply mining user emotional information and complex social interactions on social media. precise and personalized marketing strategy optimization by deeply mining users' emotional information and complex social interactions on social media. In this paper, a pre-trained transformer model BERT is used to transform social media text data into contextually relevant embedding vectors. Subsequently, a user social graph is constructed based on the interactions between users, and a multihead graph attention mechanism combined with an emotion-aware attention mechanism and a multi-scale attention aggregation method is used to accurately categorize users' emotional states. In this paper, we also construct a heterogeneous graph containing multiple entities and their relationships, such as users, products, brands and social media posts, and apply HGNN to learn the representation of the nodes, fusing users' behavioral characteristics and emotional information. Experimental results show that the method can improve the accuracy and sorting quality of the recommender system.

articleTitle: A Denoising Method for Online Monitoring Signals of Aluminum Electrolytic Cell Control Machines Based on Improved PSO-Optimized VMD
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In light of the serious modal aliasing problem in the traditional empirical mode decomposition method and the difficulty in selecting parameters in the variational mode decomposition method, which results in unsatisfactory denoising effects, this paper proposes a signal decomposition denoising method based on an improved particle swarm optimization to optimize variational mode decomposition. The method improves the learning factor adjustment strategy and introduces a simulated annealing algorithm to optimize the variational mode decomposition solution process. The Pearson correlation coefficient is employed to filter effective signal components, followed by wavelet threshold denoising to process the remaining components. Denoising experiments on both simulated and actual collected signals confirm that the proposed method outperforms existing mainstream methods and achieves superior denoising performance under different slot conditions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Singular Value Thresholding for Improving Ultrasound Molecular Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Ultrasound molecular imaging (USMI) is a highly promising diagnostic technology that can significantly enhance the diagnosis of diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and atherosclerosis. The real-time separation technique in USMI can identify and separate three components: motion microbubble (Mb), static Mb, and surrounding tissue. Static Mb imaging is widely applied in targeted cancer therapy. The technology to separate static Mb from motion Mb first requires an algorithm to distinguish microbubble and tissue signals, and the latest method for this is Singular Value Thresholding (SVT). In this paper, we propose an adaptive SVT threshold method based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for microbubble and tissue separation imaging, termed PCA-MBS (Principal Component Analysis - Microbubble Separation). In the proposed method, SVT is used to separate Mb and tissue, while PCA-MBS is used to determine the optimal truncation threshold for SVT to separate the two components. Computer simulation was conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that the contrast-to-tissue ratio (CTR) of motion Mb increased by 2.1% compared to the truncation threshold. In summary, the proposed method improves the efficiency of the SVT method in separating the two components and enhances the CTR of motion Mb after separation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Navigation Design for Underground Parking Lots Based on YOLOv5 and A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the process of urbanization, the widespread use of underground parking lots has introduced new challenges for vehicle localization and navigation, especially in environments where satellite signals are unavailable. To address this issue, this study designs an intelligent navigation system based on YOLOv5 and an improved A* algorithm. Firstly, the YOLOv5 model is utilized for precise parking space detection on the parking lot layout, constructing a clear distribution map of parking spaces. Subsequently, image preprocessing and line-by-line scanning techniques are employed to identify the layout of roads and obstacles. To enhance navigation efficiency, the system precomputes and stores path data between parking spaces. Additionally, an improved A* algorithm is proposed to achieve fast and accurate path searching. Experimental results show that the YOLOv5s model achieves a detection accuracy of 93.93% in parking space detection. After introducing the FF-EIoU loss function, the accuracy improves to 98.49%, and the efficiency of navigation path planning increases by approximately 13%.

articleTitle: LiRe: Efficient Query Rewriting for Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of information retrieval technologies, query rewriting has become a key technique for enhancing retrieval effectiveness. In the context of the widespread application of large language models and retrieval-augmented generation technologies, high-quality query rewriting plays a crucial role in tasks like open-domain question answering. Conventional Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) methods often prioritize human-friendly query formulation, which may not consistently produce optimal retriever-friendly results. To address this limitation, we present LiRe, a lightweight and training-free query rewriting system. LiRe employs a retrieval-oriented strategy to refine queries, optimizing them for retrievers. This approach allows for seamless integration into diverse Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Our approach involves problem categorization, keyword augmentation from contextual information, and integration with the filtering process. LiRe-enhanced queries demonstrate superior performance compared to existing CQR methods, as evidenced by experimental outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on Office Digitalization Situation Assessment Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To improve the problem that traditional algorithms cannot evaluate the security situation of complex office networks, this paper studies a deep learning based office digital situation assessment method to address the challenges brought by the increasing complexity of network environments to network security assessment. The study proposes an evaluation model consisting of three stages: data acquisition, analysis, and evaluation, aimed at automatically extracting features through deep learning technology to improve the accuracy and efficiency of digital state assessment in office environments. The model utilizes autoencoders for data dimensionality reduction and uses deep neural networks to classify and predict data, in order to analyze behavioral patterns and changes in office environments. In addition, the study also introduced an improved autoencoder algorithm, which improves the dimensionality reduction effect through sparsity constraints and correction coefficients, and uses Dropout technology to prevent overfitting and enhance the model's generalization ability. The experimental part uses TensorFlow framework and NSL-KDD dataset for training and testing, and the results show that the proposed method outperforms existing algorithms in multiple evaluation metrics, especially showing significant accuracy improvement in U2R attack mode.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Terminal Image Measurement System Based on Human-Computer Interaction and Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the current terminal section of the wire harness is difficult to complete the quality inspection by human eye, a set of terminal image measurement and analysis software system is developed based on software design and development and image measurement and analysis technology. First of all, according to the manual inspection process, the software demand analysis and functional process design are carried out to form a standardized industrial software architecture and framework module. Then, combined with the camera software control development and image acquisition analysis, the image measurement task set is realized, and the measurement purpose of each dimension of the terminal image target is achieved. Finally, the image measurement module is integrated into the software system, and integrated into user login management, dongle management, database management and report management to achieve an industrial software system that meets the commercial landing standards. The experimental test results show that the system is conducive to reducing the burden of manual visual inspection, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of wire harness terminal quality inspection.

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Remote Test System Based on Optical Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problems of wireless communication equipment (equipment) with complex technologies, difficult fault law prediction, and high detection conditions, the traditional “point-to-point” offline maintenance detection mode for specific types of equipment adopted in RF signal testing is changed. A radio frequency remote test solution based on acquisition and test separation, radio frequency optical fiber transmission, test instrument sharing and other technologies is proposed. Through this solution, centralized management and time-sharing multiplexing of remote test instruments, remote transmission and control of radio frequency signals are realized. At the same time, it is combined with networked automatic test technology to realize ordering intelligent network testing of wireless communication equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Security Assessment Orchestration Method for Industrial Control Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of Internet technology and industrial digitalization, many new technologies have been applied to industrial control networks. The level of intelligence and automation of industrial control networks is constantly improving, but it also brings more risks and challenges to the security of industrial control networks. Industrial control networks are highly coupled with information systems, and suffering from network attacks will lead to huge impacts and losses. Risk assessment, as a proactive means to discover potential risks in the system, has therefore attracted much attention. However, the current risk assessment of industrial control networks is mostly carried out manually, which is inefficient and relies on expert experience. And a large number of security tools are used in the assessment process, which lack integration and are highly specialized. To address these issues, we propose an assessment orchestration method that uses a knowledge map of narrow network security to integrate security tools. The security tools are then formed into an orchestration architecture as atomic services. The workflow engine and orchestration engine are used to integrate typical playbook scenarios, and finally the playbook scenarios are aggregated to form a risk assessment scenario. The risk assessment report is obtained by running and circulating the scenario.

articleTitle: A Design of Radar High-Speed Data Storage Module Based on VPX
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increase of AD sampling rate, the amount of original radar IF data also increases. In this paper, a radar high-speed data module is designed based on VPX standard to ensure a high enough radar data recording speed and storage capacity. The module adopts the architecture of FPGA+CPU, making full use of the high-speed parallel computing and processing capability of FPGA and the data management capability of CPU file system. NVME SSD using PCIE bus greatly improves data interaction and storage rate. The module can run in two RC working modes based on FPGA or CPU respectively, which reflects high flexibility. The components of hardware circuit, data flow analysis and high speed PCB layout are studied and introduced in detail. The analysis shows that the radar high speed data storage module designed in this paper has many characteristics, such as fast speed, large capacity, high reliability and strong flexibility, and can meet the requirements of data storage in the new era.

articleTitle: A Land-Air Amphibious Bionic Robot Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of robotics technology, amphibious robots have been playing an important role in military reconnaissance, resource exploration, search and rescue, environmental protection and scientific research. Amphibious bionic robots have become a research hotspot because they fully simulate the characteristics and behavioural principles of natural organisms, break through the shortcomings of traditional land and air robots such as low ground obstacle-crossing ability, bulky mobile devices, low motion efficiency, weak flight performance, etc., and are able to adapt to complex and changeable environments and tasks better. In this paper, based on the principle of bionics and self-reconfiguring robotic system, a heterogeneous self-reconfiguring land and air amphibious bionic robot is proposed around solving the technological difficulties of land and air amphibious bionic robots in terms of ground bionic motion, heterogeneous self-reconfiguration, aerial flight endurance and stability, and the main work includes:(1) Based on the principle of bionics and self-reconfigurable robot system, we mimic the cheetah's movement characteristics and leg structure, construct a mathematical model of bionic robot's ground movement, and propose a bionic leg mechanism and a new heterogeneous modular structure. (2) The D-H parametric method is used to calculate the foot-end position of the leg mechanism, and the angles of the hip, knee and ankle joints are solved in reverse; (3) Establish the kinematic model of robot ground walking and air flight, build the robot control system based on SIMULINK platform;(4) Based on STM32 and Raspberry Pi, build the robot ground motion control system and air flight control system, complete the control circuit schematic and PCB design;

articleTitle: Simulation Study Based on the Magnus Roller Air Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As time progresses, natural energy consumption has intensified, and renewable energy technologies still require breakthroughs. The Magnus effect, discovered in the mid-19th century, was largely neglected for a long period but has garnered attention in recent decades. This study focuses on the Magnus roller aircraft, utilizing numerical simulations to investigate its lift-enhancement principles and aerodynamic performance, and analyzing the relationship between the roller and lift and drag coefficients. By adjusting the circumferential speed ratio, Reynolds number, and size to optimize its performance, it was found that the lift coefficient positively correlates with the circumferential speed ratio, while the drag coefficient exhibits an inverse relationship. Under laminar flow conditions, the lift and drag coefficients linearly correlate with the Reynolds number, but above a certain threshold, the lift force no longer increases with the Reynolds number. Increasing the size enhances stability but requires more energy to drive.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Yoga Instruction Method Based on Lightweight Human Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The surge in online physical instruction during the pandemic highlights the suitability of yoga for remote teaching due to its flexible requirements. However, improper poses can lead to injury and reduced effectiveness. Traditional methods, such as in-person classes and videos, face challenges like lack of personalized guidance and time constraints. This paper introduces a lightweight human pose estimation model, Rep-LwPose, designed for real-time yoga pose recognition. It balances high accuracy with improved detection speed. Additionally, we developed YogaPose, a dataset and pose library, providing a foundation for effective yoga instruction. This approach aims to enhance practitioners' learning, reduce injury risks, and promote yoga's popularity.

articleTitle: Application Research of Distribution Network Protection Service Based on 5G LAN Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The distribution network protection service has high requirements for communication delay, reliability and stability. There are some problems in optical fiber communication and traditional 5G network. This paper first analyzes the distribution network protection service and the key technologies of 5G LAN, and analyzes its technical adaptability, then verifies the networking ability of 5G LAN, and carries out the pilot application of distribution network differential protection based on 5G LAN networking, providing reference for the promotion of 5G bearing distribution network protection service.

articleTitle: A Radar Extended Target Detection Method Based on Prior Information
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) broadband signal detection, traditional energy detectors face the issue of “clutter loss” and do not fully utilize prior information about target echoes. This article proposes an extended target detection method based on feature square matching, which leverages prior information from high-SNR echoes. Using the CLEAN algorithm, it extracts the positional information of strong scattering points in the pulse-compressed echoes to construct a prior template. This template is formed by combining rectangular windows and is then square-matched with the observed data to accumulate the signal energy within the noise. Additionally, to address performance degradation of the feature square matching detector due to inaccuracies in prior information, an energy accumulation method is introduced for cooperative detection. This aims to achieve a broadband extended target detector with broader angular adaptability, enhanced detection performance, and improved robustness.

articleTitle: Transferable Feature Pose Alignment Network for Fault Detection on Unseen Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the challenge of collecting fault data from high-end equipment for training fault diagnosis models, this paper proposes a transferable Feature Pose Alignment Network (FPAN), which enables the transfer of a trained fault diagnosis model to other machines using only healthy data. The network employs a self-supervised contrastive learning strategy to automatically partition the feature space and generate high-dimensional feature poses for each fault type. Fault types are then identified through a multi-layer attention mechanism and classifier. During feature pose generation and model transfer, a pose alignment strategy based on the Pearson correlation coefficient is established. By aligning the feature poses of new machines with those of old machines, diagnostic knowledge can be shared. Experimental results demonstrate that by aligning the feature poses of normal data from new machines with those from old machines, it is possible to use the fault diagnosis model of the old machine for fault detection in the new machine.

articleTitle: Weak Signal Detection Technology Based on Adaptive Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Adaptive filtering technology has been widely used in fields such as electronic communication and sonar detection, especially in the detection of weak signals, such as high-precision acquisition of microvolt level voltage signals. Using adaptive filtering technology to accurately detect weak signals in strong noise backgrounds and issue timely alerts. Using a digital signal processor to implement adaptive filtering for weak signal detection, improving the separation between signal and noise. By designing an adjustable bandpass filter based on LRC resonant circuit and combining it with adaptive filtering algorithm, high-precision acquisition of wideband weak signals is achieved, improving the reconnaissance effect on target signals.

articleTitle: Joint Secure Beamforming Design Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) has become a key technology that play a vital role in communication or radar systems. Consider a multiple-input single-output (MISO) downlink system assisted by RIS with a legitimate user and eavesdropper, we propose a learning algorithm to maximize the system secrecy rate by joint design the transmit beamforming and the phase shift matrix. First, a secrecy rate maximization problem of this secure communication system is formulated, subject to a power budget constraint and the unit-modulus phase shift constraints. Then, we develop a learning algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to address the non-convex optimization problem, rather than utilizing the alternating optimization (AO) techniques (which alternatively search the locally optimal solution) in literature. Simulation result confirm that the proposed DRL-based method can deliver an even higher secrecy rate, while also maintaining an acceptable speed of convergence.

articleTitle: A Method for Detecting Abnormal ADS-B Data Using the VAE-GAN-LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Broadcast Automatic Dependent Surveillance (ADS-B) is a crucial component of the next generation air traffic management system in civil aviation. Due to the lack of data encryption and authentication in the protocol, it is vulnerable to data attacks. In order to detect ADS-B data attack accurately, a method of ADS-B data anomaly detection based on VAE-GAN-LSTM is proposed according to ADS-B data characteristics. First, the trajectory data is used for training, and the feature expression of ADS-B data is automatically learned from the data; then, the potential distribution of ADS-B data features is learned by using the Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM) as the codec of VAE-GAN; finally, the data is reconstructed from the potential space by using the generation characteristics of VAE-GAN, and the possible abnormal data are detected by analyzing the difference between the reconstructed data and the real data. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively detect abnormal ADS-B data, and the detection results have high precision and recall, and the overall detection effect is good.

articleTitle: Research on Return Link Superframe Timeslot Allocation Algorithm Based on DVB-RCS2
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasing demand for high-speed interactive services, for Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) satellite communications with scarce bandwidth resources, the resource management of GEO satellite return link is the key to improving satellite bandwidth resource utilization and ensuring quality of service (QoS) for users of different sizes and priorities. This paper proposes a Constant Return Carrier Resource Allocation (CRCRA) algorithm under Multi-frequency Time Division Multiple Access (MF-TDMA) based on fixed backhaul carrier, which optimizes the timeslot allocation under MF-TDMA frame structure with different symbol rate bandwidth carriers when different priority users send service requests simultaneously. By building simulation models on Satellite Network Simulator 3 (SNS3) and VSCode, and comparing the Return Channel Satellite Terminal (RCST) response rate with the classical timeslot allocation algorithm with different priority. It is verified that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the carrier slot utilization and meet the Qos of different RCST.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Visual Tracking Based on Probabilistic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Currently, in the realm of mainstream visual transformer, attention mechanisms have proven effect in capturing features, yet the extraction of local features and the efficiency of feature fusion remains suboptimal. Aiming at above problems, a Transformer visual tracking algorithm based on probabilistic prediction is proposed. This algorithm, based on the Swin Transformer backbone, generates the probability density of feature vectors through probabilistic prediction methods enhancing the acquisition of local features, and improves the accuracy of bounding box regression based on a probabilistic regression model. Comparative experiments have been performed on multiple datasets, the precision and success rate on the OTB-100 dataset respectively reach 93.2% and the success rate of 71.7%. The SR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.75</inf> index on the GOT-10K dataset is improved by 0.039 compared with the baseline algorithm SwinTrack. The P index on the LaSOT dataset improved by 0.039 compared with the baseline algorithm SwinTrack, and the P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Norm</inf> index on the TrackingNet dataset improved by 0.025 compared with the baseline algorithm SwinTrack.

articleTitle: Chip Surface Character Detection System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A machine vision based chip surface character detection system has been designed to address the defects caused by characters on the chip surface in actual production. The system includes an image acquisition device and software processing algorithms. Firstly, extract the region of interest (ROI) of the chip character by inputting a template image. Then, the template character image is segmented into individual characters using the connected domain labeling method, and a template character library is established. Secondly, based on the template matching method, obtain the best matching position coordinates and extract the geometric features of the characters. Finally, characters are detected based on the number of connected domains, area and perimeter features, Hu moment, centroid coordinates, and edge contours. The experimental results show that the method used can effectively segment characters affected by defects and accurately detect the presence of defects on the chip surface characters.

articleTitle: A Cluster Analysis of Power Load Forecasting Based on Power Consumption Data and Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasing of the big data volume for power consumption data and the complexity of meteorological data, it has become more difficult to cope with the power load forecasting in the recent energy crisis. To address this issue, we analyze the power consumption data and meteorological data in this paper, which would be applied in developing a more effective power load management for the intelligent power systems. We develop a hybrid day-ahead load forecasting models based on K-means clustering algorithm well-known neural networks Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)). To study the impact of meteorological factors on power load forecasting, a cluster analysis is also conducted in this work to classify temperature data and rainfall data, which aims to mine the relationship between power consumption data and meteorological data. In the experiments on the public data sets, the performance evaluation of the proposed method is compared with the commonly used algorithms for power load forecasting. In the numerical results, it is shown that the proposed method performs higher accuracy and applicability compared with the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Optical Chip Testing Platform Based on Image Recognition and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: An optical chip test platform integrating image acquisition, image preprocessing, deep learning classification and result feedback is designed, and the automatic classification of optical chips is realized. The optical chip classification model combines Bi-FPN and CBAM attention mechanism to improve the YOLOv5 model and effectively improve the model's detection ability of small target defects under complex background. The proposed method is compared with other methods, and the superiority of the improved YOLOv5 model in optical chip classification is verified. The important role of Bi-FPN module and CBAM attention mechanism in improving the recognition and classification of optical chips is further analyzed through ablation experiments, which has certain practical value for realizing automatic classification of optical chips.

articleTitle: Identification of Lycium Barbarum Aphid Disease Based on Improved YOLOv11
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Addressing the issue where farmers struggle to identify Lycium barbarum aphid infestations during the growth process, leading to missed optimal control opportunities and subsequent economic losses, this paper proposes a method for identifying Lycium barbarum aphid infestations based on an improved YOLOv11 algorithm. Firstly, the Shape-IoU bounding box regression loss calculation method is employed to calculate loss by focusing on the shape and scale of the bounding box itself, resulting in more accurate bounding box regression. Secondly, the Lightweight Adaptive Extraction (LAE) module is utilized to optimize the target detection network model of YOLOv11, reducing parameters and computational costs. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with the unimproved YOLOv11 algorithm, the improved YOLOv11 algorithm achieves a 2.7% increase in mean Average Precision (mAP) and a 9% increase in F1 score, validating the feasibility of this method.

Author Keywords: Identification of Lycium barbarum aphid disease

articleTitle: Research on Controlling Gas Flow in Fuel Cells Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of technology, improving energy utilization and addressing pollution issues have become urgent tasks. As an emerging field within new energy, fuel cells play a significant role in enhancing energy efficiency and extending service life. The power generation efficiency of fuel cells is primarily related to the stoichiometric ratio of oxygen. Therefore, this article will use the PID control algorithm to regulate the gas flow of the fuel cell, specifically by controlling the numerical value of the oxygen stoichiometric ratio of the fuel cell, which in turn regulates the air flow. This aims to improve energy utilization efficiency, enhance battery power generation efficiency, and extend.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and Numerical Study of Smart Phone
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasing diversification of people's lives, smart phones are playing an increasingly important role in People's Daily life. With the continuous increase of mobile phone functions, the computing power requirements of mobile phone chips are also getting higher and higher. However, a chip with strong computing power will lead to a sharp increase in the heat of the phone, and if the heat is not dissipated in time, it will increase the risk of damage to the internal electronic components of the phone, which will greatly reduce the service life of the phone. Therefore, how to effectively dissipate heat in a limited space and improve heat transfer efficiency has become an urgent problem to be solved. To solve this problem, this research mainly adopts the method of simulation to explore. Since the phone model is relatively simple, gambit is used for modeling. Then, the fluent software is used to simulate the internal flow field of the mobile phone, and the improvement suggestions of the heat dissipation scheme are put forward accordingly. Considering the high density of electronic components in mobile phones, heat transfer is mainly based on heat transfer. Therefore, this study starts from heat transfer and focuses on the relationship between dimensionless number and time change of mobile phone chip in heat transfer process, in order to provide useful reference for mobile phone heat dissipation design.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of State Estimation Methods and Neural Network Prediction Algorithms in Optoelectronic Tracking Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Optoelectronic tracking systems are widely utilized in fields such as laser communication, aerospace, and astronomical observation. However, the randomness and high maneuverability of tracking targets pose significant challenges, including system closed-loop bandwidth limitations caused by time delays in image sensors, reduced tracking accuracy due to the target's strong maneuverability and weak motion patterns, and frequent occlusion by environmental objects when targets move at low altitudes. To address these challenges, this paper investigates optoelectronic tracking technology based on two different types of prediction methods, comparing their predictive performance to mitigate the issue of data loss.

articleTitle: Carrier Tracking Loop Control for GNSS Signals Based on Error-Based ADRC
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) provides a wide range of services. In highly dynamic environments, satellite signals are often corrupted by noise during transmission, and thermal noise in the receiver introduces additional errors. To mitigate the effects of Doppler shift and noise in the tracking loop and achieve accurate and stable tracking of satellite navigation signals, this paper investigates the signal tracking loop of GNSS receivers. An error-based Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) loop filter is utilized, and a method for dynamically adjusting the bandwidth of the Linear Extended State Observer (LESO) is proposed. This method enhances the robustness and flexibility of the control system, thereby improving tracking accuracy and anti-interference capability in GNSS applications. The proposed method was tested on a simulation platform, demonstrating a low tracking error standard deviation under the same carrier-to-noise ratio (C/N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>) conditions and strong tracking performance in highly dynamic environments, including accurate prediction of Doppler shifts. Experimental results validate the algorithm's effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: OPRNet: A Novel Network Architecture for Efficient Landmark-Based Place Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Landmark-based methods combining landmarks and features from convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated cutting-edge performance in visual place recognition (VPR), especially under simultaneous changes in appearance and viewpoint. However, current methods often depend on pre-trained networks tailored for image classification, neglecting the optimal network structure for landmark-based VPR. In this study, we showcase the significance of multi-frequency feature maps for VPR by developing a simple, lightweight network named OPRNet (Octave Place Recognition Network), which utilizes a streamlined octave convolution for landmark extraction. OPRNet not only maintains robust recognition capabilities but also achieves a significant reduction in network parameters to 3.3MB and over 50% speedup, compared to more complex traditional networks. Additionally, we incorporate various popular network structures into OPRNet to evaluate their impact on recognition performance. This research may serve as a valuable reference for future landmark-based VPR network designs, particularly in diverse recognition scenarios.

articleTitle: A Linearized High-Efficiency Power Amplifier Based on Optimized Bias Point
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: It is well known that power amplifiers suffer from a lack of linearity at saturation. Based on the intermodulation distortion Sweet Spot generation principle, this paper explores optimizing high-efficiency power amplifier performance and maintaining the linearity performance at a lower power back-off level. By adjusting the gate bias voltage, IMD sweet spot occurs at a back-off level so that the proposed design can achieve higher efficiency and better linearity. This paper presents a qualitative analysis of the relationship between IMD behavior and quiescent bias point under Class F matching conditions, and the Gallium Nitride transistor CGH40010F is used to design a 1.5 GHz high-efficiency power amplifier to support it. Measurement results show that the over 70% drain efficiency and 41.5 dBm output power are realized at 1.45-1.55 GHz, −30 dBc third-order intermodulation distortion are reached at 3dB back-off.

articleTitle: Timing Characteristic Extraction Design of Large-Scale Complex Digital-Analog Interface Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To enable data transmission between the digital and analog modules on a chip, it is necessary to design analog-digital interface circuits. However, when supply voltage and clock phase between digital and analog modules are different, and circuit scale of analog-digital interface circuit is huge, the timing characterization of analog-digital interface circuits are a very challenging work. Given this issue, the interface circuit and virtual triggers are instantiated at top level, and timing characteristics were extracted by characterization EDA tool Liberate AMS. Under different PVT conditions and loads, the timing results in PrimeTime are compared with precise values obtained from simulation in HSPICE. The results show that the maximum error produced by automated characterization falls within the range of 3%, which validates the accuracy of characterization. In comparison to current characterization methods for standard cells, this approach can achieve efficient and accurate timing characterization for large-scale and complex mixed-signal circuits, making it highly valuable in the integrated circuit design process.

articleTitle: Constructed Depth Face Anti-Spoofing Method Fused with Local Texture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The existing face anti-spoofing methods based on deep neural networks perform excellently now, but many approaches tend to neglect the distinctions in texture and structure between real faces and spoofed faces. To address this issue, a face anti-spoofing technique is proposed that leverages multi-scale local texture and constructed depth. Initially, the Swin Transformer is utilized to extract local features and create deep representations. Subsequently, the Swin Transformer, comprising four stages, encodes these image patches, with the outputs from different stages combined to produce the constructed depth descriptors and local texture features. Ultimately, the classification of the input face image is achieved by integrating both the local texture features and the constructed depth map. Experiments are conducted on a widely used short-range scene dataset and a newly released long-distance scene dataset. In the OULU-NPU dataset, the average classification error rates of the four protocols are 0.2%, 0.9%, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{1.6\pm1.7\%}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{2.6\pm2.1\%}$</tex>, respectively. It also achieves a high recognition rate on protocol 3 of SuHiFiMask dataset. Experiments show that the superiority of the proposed method over the majority of mainstream methods, and has good recognition performance.

articleTitle: Vehicle Diagnostic Evaluation Based on Testability Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the traditional diagnostic development process, component oriented diagnosis is often emphasized while system oriented diagnosis is ignored, and the automotive industry has not yet developed mature methods to evaluate the level of system level diagnostic development. Based on the industry background of lacking system level diagnostic design, this study starts from the current situation of diagnostic development and evaluation, combines the theory of testability and the indicator system based on testability, discusses the problems of insufficient diagnostic coverage and accuracy in the field of automotive development and design, and points out the difficulty of lacking effective diagnostic evaluation methods. Then, a diagnostic evaluation method based on testability theory was established from two dimensions: the steps and methods of automotive diagnostic evaluation, and the diagnostic evaluation was divided into six stages. Elaborate on the calculation method of diagnostic evaluation through the correlation matrix between failure modes and fault phenomena, and illustrate the evaluation schemes for failure fuzzy groups, redundant testing, and undetectable failures through case studies.

articleTitle: Design and Control of High Precision Buoyancy Adjustment System for Small AUVs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of buoyancy variation caused by differences in seawater density at varying operational depths for small AUVs working within 200 meters. To tackle this, a buoyancy adjustment system is designed that uses a piston-type oil cylinder to take in and release oil. The system integrates a digital-to-analog converter with a cable sensor to achieve precise measurement and control of the oil volume by accurately measuring the piston position. A mathematical model of the buoyancy adjustment system is established, and a fuzzy PID control strategy optimized by the Beetle Antennae Search (BAS) algorithm is proposed. Through Simulink simulation analysis, the system's precision adjustment capability and stability are validated. The simulation results demonstrate that the system exhibits good control performance in terms of adjustment time, overshoot, and disturbance rejection, thereby proving its reliability and feasibility.

articleTitle: STM32-Based Single-Phase Inverter Power Supply Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) signals in motor control [1] In this paper, the basic method of generating SPWM signal on STM32 microcontroller is introduced. This paper firstly introduces the basic method of generating SPWM signals on STM32 microcontroller, and then improves the existing code and realizes the corresponding algorithm in MATLAB. The improved method not only improves the readability and maintainability of the code, but also increases the waveform type selection and PID control functions, which makes the generation of SPWM signals more flexible and precise.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Service Caching, Task Migration and Resource Allocation for Vehicular Edge Computing with Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Effective integration of available resources within edge nodes is essential to improve the performance of vehicular edge computing (VEC) to support various randomly offloaded tasks with limited computing capacity and constrained energy. This paper presents an intelligent adaptive resource integration strategy for VEC with harvesting energy. Service caching, task migration and resource allocation are jointly employed to accommodate the temporally and spatially varying computing demands. The optimization to minimize the long-term average task execution time under energy constraint is formulated as Markov decision processes and solved with a parameterized deep Q-network based learning algorithm. This algorithm employs a centralized training and distributed execution framework, where a parameter network and an action network respectively handle continuous and discrete decisions, effectively tackling the hybrid action space challenges in problem solving. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm not only achieves faster convergence but also significantly improves system performance compared to benchmarks.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex and Transparent Transmission Scheme of SPI Bus
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To take full advantage of the communication capability of SPI Bus, and maximize the transmission capacity of SPI bus, a transparent transmission scheme for full-duplex communication is designed. Firstly, a hierarchical architecture for communication nodes is designed, which contains two modules: top processing module and underlying communication module. The modules run in parallel mode and a data buffering mechanism is established between them for data exchange; Secondly, based on the hierarchical architecture, a full-duplex transparent data transmission mechanism for independent transmission and reception is designed. The top processing module performs independent receiving and sending operations, while the underlying communication modules use data transparency for data transmission. Both two-way communication can use valid data and can be performed simultaneously. By improving the software algorithm, make full use of the full-duplex communication capability of SPI bus, realize bidirectional and simultaneous data transmission, and greatly improving the data transmission efficiency of the SPI bus.

articleTitle: Simulation Design and Analysis of Effector Amplifier Circuit Based on Multisim
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper investigates the design and analysis of a common-source amplifier circuit using an enhancement-mode NMOS field-effect transistor (FET). The primary focus is on evaluating the amplifier's performance under different input signal conditions, with particular attention given to gain and distortion characteristics. Through simulation and analysis, the paper explores the impact of input amplitude variation on the static operating point, linearity, and total harmonic distortion (THD). The study first establishes the DC operating point and examines the circuit's behavior under small-signal inputs, demonstrating that the amplifier achieves a stable gain when the input signal remains within a specified range (e.g., 0.5mV and 1mV). As the amplitude increases, the circuit gradually enters a nonlinear operating region, resulting in positive and negative peak deviations and severe waveform distortion. This is confirmed by a significant rise in THD values, which reaches 12.52% for a 10mV input, indicating the onset of clipping distortion. The results underscore the importance of selecting an appropriate input range to ensure signal integrity. The inclusion of distortion measurement tools within the testing framework is emphasized as a practical method for real-time monitoring and optimization. This research not only validates the theoretical principles governing NMOS amplifier circuits but also provides insights for designers to optimize performance and minimize distortion. Future work can expand on these findings to investigate the effects of frequency response, parasitic capacitances, and other non-ideal factors on overall circuit stability and performance.

articleTitle: High-Precision Adaptive Ischemic Training Device
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This project designs a compact, high-precision adaptive ischemic training device that utilizes modern sensing technology and adaptive algorithms to provide personalized rehabilitation plans for patients with cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. The device accurately monitors users' physiological parameters through decision tree algorithms and adjusts training parameters adaptively based on blood pressure conditions, thereby enhancing rehabilitation effectiveness. This project not only demonstrated significant effects in clinical trials for reducing blood pressure and improving vascular function but also offers portability and ease of use, making it suitable for patients to use independently at home. The high-precision adaptive ischemic training device promotes the development of smart healthcare, alleviating the burden on the medical system and improving patients' quality of life.

articleTitle: Security Risk Assessment System for Power Monitoring Systems Based on Zero Trust Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of cyberspace, power systems face increasingly severe challenges from external hacker attacks and internal risks. Traditional security models based on perimeter defense can no longer meet the high-security requirements of modern power monitoring systems. This paper proposes a security risk assessment system for power monitoring systems based on the zero trust security model, aiming to address the challenges of external hacker attacks and internal risks faced by power systems. The system collects and analyzes various data in real time, using modular processing and a comprehensive scoring mechanism, and dynamically generates security status levels. On this basis, it implements security policies. Experimental results show that the system can effectively identify and respond to security threats, significantly reducing false alarms or missed alarms caused by single data sources and providing an efficient and reliable security solution for the power monitoring field.

articleTitle: Joint Waveform and Mismatched Filter Design Against Interrupted Sampling Repeater Jamming in Spectrally Crowded Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In modern electronic warfare, interrupted sampling repeater jamming (ISRJ) poses a significant threat to pulse compression (PC) radar. Moreover, with the increasing complexity and congestion of the electromagnetic environment, the spectrum congestion problem (SCP) also draws considerable attention in radar filed. To address both ISRJ and SCP, this paper investigates a joint design of waveforms and filters to improve radar detection performance under a spectrally crowed environment with ISRJ challenge. Specifically, we formulate a cost function with Pareto factors to balance the weak target detection and anti-ISRJ performance of radar system, and employ the spectral compatibility constraint to help radar coexist with other devices. The engineering application and the constraint of noise to signal ratio output are also considered in our design. To tackle the resultant non-convex NP-hard problem, we apply the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) framework. The Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) theory is utilized to efficiently solve subproblems. Numerical experiments demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Crack Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv11n Network
