publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The detection algorithms for various engineering structure cracks often suffer from missed detections, false positives, and low accuracy. This paper proposes an improved crack detection model based on Yolov11, integrating RFCBAM and Triplet Attention mechanisms. Experimental results show that this model performs better in detection compared to the original model and those improved by a single mechanism. The metrics for Precision (P), Recall (R), mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>, and mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50−95</inf> all reach high levels.

articleTitle: Research on Road Damage Detection Based on an Improved YOLOv8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents the YOLOv8 model for road damage detection, highlighting performance enhancements. YOLOv8 features a novel backbone network, an anchor-free detection head, and new loss functions, ensuring efficient operation across various hardware platforms. A self-attention mechanism is integrated to enhance classification accuracy and robustness. Experimental comparisons indicate that while the attention-augmented YOLOv8 improves precision and recall, the modified version achieves superior overall performance. Analyses using confusion matrices and precision-recall curves demonstrate the enhanced YOLOv8's greater accuracy and stability with complex backgrounds and diverse damage types. The results confirm its superiority in practical applications, showcasing strong performance in road damage detection.

articleTitle: Research on SOH Prediction of Lithium Battery Based on Improved SSA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The rapid growth of electric vehicles has led to widespread adoption of lithium batteries in energy systems, valued for their high energy density and extended cycle life. Nonetheless, frequent charge-discharge cycles and environmental conditions contribute to capacity loss, which ultimately reduces vehicle longevity. As a vital metric, the state of health (SOH) of lithium batteries is challenging to measure directly, and traditional methods often lack precision in SOH prediction. This study gathers experimental data on battery aging under various charge-discharge conditions and incorporates NASA's B05 battery data to identify health metrics. Correlation analysis is used to select optimized input variables. A BP neural network model, enhanced by the sparrow search algorithm (SSA), is developed. Furthermore, combining Levy flight and the sine cosine algorithm (SCA) improves prediction accuracy for SOH.

articleTitle: A Similarity Evaluation Method Based on Fine-Grained Weighted Image Entropy for Information Loss in ISAR Multi-Precision Fusion Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the challenge of effectively evaluating ISAR image similarity under multi-precision fusion processing, this paper proposes a Fine-Grained Weighted Entropy (FGWE)-based image similarity evaluation method. This approach fully considers the subtle structural features in radar images by assigning different entropy weights to various regions, thereby emphasizing the differences of the important structural information and then reflecting accurately the similarity between images. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with traditional methods, when FGWE was used to evaluate radar images, it showed a greater sensitivity to structural feature differences, and more accurately trapped the image information loss which derived from multi-precision processing. The mentioned FGWE reveals great potential in the field of radar image precision evaluation.

articleTitle: Definition of Buck Converter Loss Equivalent Resistance and Its Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the energy loss problem of the Buck converter, this paper proposes a loss analysis method based on the equivalent resistance model, and accurately defines and identifies the loss equivalent resistance. First, the equivalent resistance model is established by analyzing the loss mechanism of the switching tubes, inductors, capacitors and other major components of the Buck converter, and the definition method of the equivalent resistance parameters is proposed. Then, based on the energy flow model of the Buck converter, an efficient equivalent resistance identification method is designed to realize the accurate modeling of the converter loss characteristics. The experimental and simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the loss analysis accuracy of the Buck converter, which is of guiding significance for optimizing the design and improving the energy efficiency of the converter.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Steel is widely used in daily life. With the development and progress of society, the scale of steel materials is increasing, and due to various factors, problems such as corrosion and cracks are inevitable. If it is not handled in time, it may bring incalculable losses. Therefore, it is particularly important to test and evaluate facilities in advance. In this paper, a method of defect inversion by deep learning is designed, and the size information of defects is inverted by deep learning, so as to evaluate the defect level. By analyzing the relationship between magnetic signal and defect size, the relationship eigenvalue is extracted to complete the inversion. The application of this method can help inspectors to quickly reverse the defect size and complete the defect grade evaluation. In addition, the research of this method has certain reference significance for the application of deep learning.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Mobile Robot Based on Improved Aquila Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved Aquila optimizer (IAO) addressing the path planning problem of mobile robots. First, chaos mapping is used to initialize the population, enhancing the algorithm's global exploration abilities. To escape local optima, Cauchy- Gaussian mutation perturbations are introduced. Finally, to overcome the limitations of the traditional Aquila optimizer, the energy switching mechanism of the Harris hawks optimization (HHO) are introduced. Achieving an effective balance between global exploration. We present the experimental results of benchmark function tests and global exploration strategies. The comparative experimental results and robot path planning show that improved Aquila optimizer exhibits a faster convergence speed and better optimization capability. It demonstrates high effectiveness and stability in mobile robot path planning.

articleTitle: Design of Portable Multiple Outputs Adjustable DC Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Adjustable DC power supplies are essential tools in electronic laboratories, offering precise control over voltage (CV mode) and current (CC mode) to meet various testing needs. This paper presents the design of a portable, multiple-output, adjustable DC power supply based on synchronous Buck and Buck-Boost converter topologies. Powered by a Li-ion battery pack (two batteries in series), the system delivers four distinct DC voltages: 3.3V, 5V, 12V, and −12V. Each output channel features independent constant current control logic, allowing for adjustable current limits or current sourcing. A Type-II feedback compensation network is used to limit the op-amp's bandwidth. Reference voltages are delivered by DACs that are controlled by MCU. To generate negative voltage, a variation a Buck topology circuit is used. Results demonstrate an output error margin of 0.46% for the 3.3V channel, 0.40% for the 5V, 0.10% for the −12V channels and 0.02% for the 12V channel. The system can provide up to 5A of current with an efficiency approaching 90%.

articleTitle: Multimodal Feature Fusion-Based Node Representation Learning for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Predicting Drug-drug interaction (DDI) is essential for drug combination therapy to reduce unexpected adverse drug reactions. However, existing methods cannot adequately consider multimodal features or molecular graph structural information, and it is a challenge to extract and fuse multimodal features effectively. In this study, we propose a multimodal feature fusion-based node representation learning for Drug-Drug interaction prediction, termed MFF-NRL. We used a graph convolutional network to extract the features of molecular graphs in terms of a node feature update strategy. Then, we take the molecular graph embeddings as a feature matrix, construct an adjacency matrix based on the DDI network, and propose a representation learning method based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism. Finally, a multimodal feature fusion module is presented to effectively integrate the molecular graph and DDI network embedding information, and the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) layer is further applied for DDI prediction. The MFF-NRL algorithm's effectiveness has been verified by four representative evaluation metrics on the ZhangDDI dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that MFF-NRL performs better than state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Multi-Path Routing in Hybrid Software-Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The emergence of new network technologies, such as Software-Defined Networking (SDN), has introduced many features to traditional networks, but SDN also presents its own challenges and limitations. Hybrid SDN combines the strengths of traditional IP networks and SDN, attracting widespread attention. However, as network size increases, traffic balancing becomes critical. Multi-path routing offers different paths for traffic with varying quality of service requirements and can provide multiple routes for the same type of traffic, thereby improving link utilization. In this paper, we propose an algorithm that integrates multi-path routing mechanisms into hybrid SDN to alleviate network congestion. Our approach addresses traffic load balancing and reduces network congestion by optimizing throughput, link utilization, and packet loss rates. The results demonstrate that our mechanism significantly reduces congestion and achieves better load balancing compared to previous approaches.

articleTitle: Research and Application of LZ-Hf Algorithm in Compression of Automotive CAN Message Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasing richness of the functions carried on top of the car, the amount of data generated on the nodes carried on the vehicle CAN bus is getting bigger and bigger, and it takes more and more time to upload the data of the collected CAN messages to the server side. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a LZ-Hf algorithm for message compression by combining the data characteristics of automotive CAN messages, and designs a data acquisition system so as to obtain CAN message data to verify the algorithm. After several tests and analysis of files of different sizes, the algorithm drastically reduces the time needed to upload the data from the TF card to the cloud.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Gait Analysis Method in Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents a gait analysis method in Parkinson's disease (PD) based on the Azure Kinect DK camera and human pose estimation algorithms, specifically RTMPose and MotionBert. The method extracts 3D human key points from RGB-D video to analyze gait parameters such as step length, step time, gait speed, arm swing magnitude, gait cycle, and turning duration. The results demonstrate significant differences in these gait parameters between Parkinson's disease patients and healthy individuals, and the method can analyze the patient's abnormal gait. The method offers a non-invasive, real-time tool for PD symptom assessment, with potential for low-cost monitoring and clinical application.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Refractive Index Sensors Based on Geometric Phase Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: We designed a highly sensitive refractive index sensor based on geometric phase metasurfaces. The unit of this sensor consists of eight rotated silver cubes, which are placed on a silicon dioxide substrate. We employed the finite-difference time-domain method to calculate the optical properties of the sensor. The background refractive index changes from 1.33 to 1.34. Experimental results indicate that due to the particularly small change in the background refractive index, the reflectance and transmittance are consistent under both refractive index conditions. This metasurface can produce both anomalous reflection (or anomalous refraction) phenomena and polarization conversion functionality. When detecting anomalous reflection (or anomalous refraction), we found a significant difference in the intensity difference of the two orthogonal polarization states of the reflected light (or transmitted light). The ratio of the intensity difference of these two orthogonal polarizations (ΔIy/ΔIx) can approach 8. This indicates that a change in the background refractive index of less than 1% can be reflected through other optical responses. Utilizing this feature, a refractive index sensor can be realized. The size of the silver cubes is much smaller than the wavelength of the incident light, allowing the silver cubes to be regarded as electric dipoles. By altering the structural dimensions and the polarization state of the incident light, the size of the electric dipole can be adjusted, optimizing Δ Iy/Δ Ix. The excitation of surface plasmons on the silver cubes depends on the polarization state of the incident light, and adjusting the polarization state of the incident light can still change Δ Iy/Δ Ix. Our findings provide new insights for designing efficient optical metasurfaces, further advancing their application potential in refractive index sensing and optical sensing fields.

articleTitle: GhostStereoNet: Stereo Matching from Cheap Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks show excellent performance in stereo vision tasks. However, most of current network architectures are complex and require high hardware resources. To handle this problem, we propose GhostStereoNet, a light weight end-to-end stereo matching network by applying Ghost modules in GwcNet. We extend the 2D Ghost bottleneck to 3<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> Ghost bottleneck and then replace the convolution layers in GwcNet with 2<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> and 3<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> Ghost bottlenecks. Compared with GwcNet-g, the number of model parameters of our architecture is reduced about 4.3 times. The proposed GhostStereoNet's performance has been demonstrated to remain competitive with the most advanced models, as evidenced by experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Security Authentication Method for Distributed SDN Network Data Transmission Based on Alliance Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: SDN, as a flexible and programmable network architecture, presents challenges in data transmission security and authentication complexity due to its distributed nature. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a secure authentication method that combines consortium blockchain with SDN. This solution utilizes the decentralized, tamper proof, and smart contract features of the consortium blockchain to effectively ensure identity authentication, data integrity, and confidentiality between network nodes. The experimental results show that this method not only significantly improves the data transmission security and reliability of SDN networks, but also maintains high data transmission efficiency of distributed SDN networks, providing strong support for building secure and reliable distributed SDN networks.

articleTitle: A Patent Quality Evaluation Method Based on Heterogeneous Graph Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The automated assessment of patent quality plays an important role in promoting technological innovation and enhancing market competitiveness. However, the existing methods cannot fully utilize the multi-dimensional features of patents, leading to low accuracy in quality assessment. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a patent quality assessment method based on heterogeneous graph networks. First, patent numerical attributes and text topics are used to construct a patent heterogeneous graph, and the meta-path is used to sample the heterogeneous subgraph into isomorphic subgraphs under various relationship views. Second, graph convolutional networks are used to perform graph embedding on the heterogeneous subgraphs to obtain patent features. Finally, the attention mechanism is used to fuse the features of all subgraphs to obtain the final representation of the patent node and conduct patent evaluation. The experimental results on two different-sized datasets extracted from the Incopat patent database show that the accuracy of the proposed method is higher than that of the previous methods, proving the feasibility and accuracy of its patent quality assessment.

articleTitle: Review of Research on Motor Imagery in the Field of Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Motor imagery has the advantages of non-invasiveness, safety and economic efficiency in post-stroke motor function rehabilitation, and has a wide application prospect in the field of medical rehabilitation. In this paper, we sort out the current status of the application of motor imagery brain-computer interface technology, summarize the development of motor imagery decoding algorithms and their application in the field of motor rehabilitation, discuss and analyze the research progress of motor imagery brain-computer interface technology in medical rehabilitation, and summarize the development trend of its development, so as to provide new therapeutic methods and ideas for the future of medical rehabilitation.

articleTitle: Passive Radar Weak Target Detection Algorithm Fused with Feature Pyramid Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Target detection is an important application of passive radar, but due to the non-cooperative characteristics of the radiation source, the target signal-to-noise ratio is too low, and the existing detection algorithms are difficult to effectively detect the target from the echo with low signal-to-noise ratio, and the problem of false detection occurs, which poses a challenge to the weak target detection of passive radar. In order to solve the above problems, the data collected by field passive radar experiments were used to make datasets, and the weak target detection experiments were carried out based on deep learning, and a passive radar weak target detection algorithm based on feature pyramid network was proposed. Firstly, a two-layer routing dynamic sparse attention mechanism is added to provide more flexible computational allocation and content awareness, and secondly, feature fusion is carried out to replace the neck network with a BiFPN network, so that the neural network can better understand and interpret multi-scale information. then, auxiliary detection heads were added to help propagate gradients better, speed up training and prevent gradient disappearance problems. Finally, using the WIoU dynamic non-monotonic focusing mechanism, it is possible to focus on the anchor frame of normal quality and improve the overall performance of the detector. In order to verify the effectiveness of the network, ablation experiments and comparative experiments were carried out. Ablation experiments show that the detection performance is improved after each improvement, the recall and average precision are increased by 3.4% and 4% respectively, and the precision is increased to 89.6% and 3.8% respectively. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm significantly reduces false detection and missed detection in passive radar weak target detection.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Parallel Deterministic Network System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the current development of industrial Internet technology, the number of interconnected industrial control devices is increasing, the throughput of key data in industrial Internet networks is increasing, and the requirements for deterministic data processing are increasing. Traditional industrial control systems generally use low-performance single-core processors, which operate the collected industrial data in a single-core and single-threaded manner, resulting in poor key data processing capabilities and a lack of data scheduling capabilities. With the development of industrial Internet technology and deterministic network technology, the parallel data processing capabilities of multi-core SoCs can effectively meet the needs of industrial real-time networks. The data flow of the industrial Internet network uses custom data identification and a parallel data processing mechanism. The data faces macro operations such as data packet matching, parsing, and forwarding to establish models, provide accurate execution mechanisms for devices in the time dimension, and effectively ensure high throughput and low-latency deterministic transmission of industrial control data.

articleTitle: An Improved Parallel Adder
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents an improved parallel adder. Based on the achievements of parallel adders developed by the team of Ternary Optical Computer(TOC), this adder introduces variable distance shifting technology, which eliminates the intermediate result storage operations in memory, thereby reducing the memory access time during the entire addition process and enhancing the operational speed of the adder. To validate the feasibility and advancement of this research, we established a corresponding experimental platform on Field-Programmable Gate Array(FPGA) and compared the performances of the two adders. Experimental results indicate that the improved parallel adder significantly outperforms the original parallel adder, demonstrating that the variable distance shifting technology effectively enhances the computational efficiency of the parallel adder.

articleTitle: The Study of Trajectory Prediction in V2X Collision Warning Based on Pruned SR-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving technology, V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) technology enhances traffic efficiency and safety through information exchange between vehicles and other road users. In V2X application scenarios, vehicle trajectory prediction is the core of collision warning systems. However, current communication systems face multiple challenges such as transmission delays, data packet loss, and limited computing power at the vehicle end, making it difficult to ensure real-time performance and accuracy. Therefore, how to achieve high-precision trajectory prediction in a constrained computing environment is an urgent issue to be resolved. This paper proposes an optimized model based on pruned SR-LSTM, significantly reducing the model's computational complexity to meet the deployment requirements at the vehicle end. During the prediction phase, this pruned SR-LSTM model improves computation speed by reducing unnecessary connections, ensuring the accuracy and real-time nature of trajectory predictions, thereby enhancing the responsiveness of the collision warning system. By combining time steps and the predicted trajectory point sequences, the system calculates the time to collision (TTC) of vehicles within a reasonable safety distance and outputs warning signals in real-time, verifying the effectiveness of the pruned LSTM in handling dynamic and complex scenarios in a V2X environment.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Human-Computer Interaction Interface of Warehouse Management Systems Using Automatic Speech Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The exponential growth of the e-commerce and logistics industries in recent years has underscored the necessity for a warehouse management system (WMS) that is more efficient and intelligent. The prevailing WMSs are dependent on manual input and the use of handheld devices, which can result in inefficiencies and the potential for human error. In this work, we propose a human-computer interaction model for speech recognition optimized for the warehouse environment. This model integrates noise suppression technology based on an adaptive filter, which can dynamically detect and filter background noise, such as forklift operation sounds, human voices, and mechanical operation sounds. Furthermore, to address the variability in pronunciation, speech rate, and accent among different users, the system incorporates a speech enhancement model based on the variational autoencoder (V AE) technique. This approach enables the system to adaptively adjust the input speech features, thereby enhancing the robustness of recognition. In regard to natural language processing, a natural language understanding module based on bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) has been developed. The module is capable of semantic parsing of instructions in the user's voice and converting them into executable operation commands. Semantic slot filling technology enables the system to automatically identify the key entities in a task and perform linkage operations with the backend WMS database. The experimental analysis demonstrates that the proposed system is effective in an actual warehouse scenario. Compared with the traditional method, the task completion speed and accuracy are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Path Smoothing for USVs Using Adaptive Quadratic Bézier Curves
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Addressing common issues in global path planning for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), such as multiple inflection points, unsmooth paths, and lengthy routes, we propose an adaptive smoothing method utilizing quadratic Bézier curves. This method refines paths generated by existing algorithms by strategically removing redundant nodes to reduce turning points and enhancing path smoothness through adaptive quadratic Bézier curves. Experimental results confirm that our approach not only reduces the path length by an average of 7.65% and decreases turn frequency by 57.07%, but also significantly outperforms under the RRT algorithm, with reductions in path length and turns by 16.38% and 90.91%, respectively. This innovative method delivers smoother, shorter paths from start to endpoint and seamlessly integrates with various path planning algorithms, thereby improving path quality and navigational efficiency. It introduces a novel perspective and methodology in the field of USVs path planning.

articleTitle: Design of a Signal Detection and Conditioning Circuit for an Inductive Oil Debris Sensor Based on Phase-Sensitive Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The monitoring of oil debris is crucial for equipment health management. However, the weak signals from inductive sensors are susceptible to noise interference, affecting detection accuracy. To address this issue, this paper presents the design of a signal detection and conditioning circuit based on phase-sensitive detection. By employing lock-in amplification technology, the circuit effectively separates signals from noise, achieving high-precision signal extraction. The circuit comprises modules for amplification, phase-sensitive detection, and filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that this design outperforms traditional methods in enhancing signal-to-noise ratio and anti-interference capability, improving the sensitivity and stability of the sensor.

articleTitle: Air Target Intention Prediction for Multiple Moments Based on PIBoost-MIPG Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the change of mode, the reasoning of the enemy's intention has been introduced into the battlefield, and the decision-making of air defense has higher requirements for intention recognition, and the existing methods such as knowledge graph, expert network, and deep neural network have obvious lagging problems in the speed of recognition, which is difficult to meet the needs of air defense. Therefore, we take advantage of deep learning to use gated recurrent units (GRU) as the basis to propose a MIPG method for future multi-moment air target intent prediction, which predicts the intent of enemy air targets multiple moments in advance and effectively solves the lag problem of intent recognition. Then, the PIBoost algorithm is proposed for the problems of the insufficient overall accuracy of prediction and insufficiently precise location of the intention inflection point in MIPG, and the experiment proves that the PIBoost-MIPG air target intention prediction method achieves good results in the multi-moment air target intention prediction problem, and provides a more rapid and powerful basis for the decision-making of air defense operations.

articleTitle: Logic Design and Safety Failure Rate Calculation of the All-Electronic Fuze Safety System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The safety of the All-Electron missile safety system is an important link to ensure the accurate detonation of the fuze. This paper uses Markov theory to analyze and calculate the probability of accidental disarming of the safety lock logic before and after the missile launch, considering the impact of the number of environmental signals and time windows on the safety failure rate. The study compares the safety failure rates under different numbers of environmental excitation signals. The results show that compared to general electromechanical and mechanical safety systems, the All-Electron fuze safety system, which uses three sensors to recognize four environmental signals and then acts on three time windows, with two ecological signals jointly acting on the same time window, has a lower safety failure rate and higher safety. It can effectively improve the missile's safety from separation to detonation.

articleTitle: Cloud Resource Load Prediction Based on EEMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of cloud computing, accurate load prediction has become essential for optimizing system performance. The nonlinear and non-stationary characteristics of cloud resource load data have increased the complexity of prediction tasks. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a multi-input multi-output load prediction model based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The model reduces data complexity through EEMD decomposition while effectively capturing the temporal dependencies in the sequence data using LSTM. Experiments conducted on publicly available cluster datasets from Alibaba demonstrate that the EEMD-LSTM model significantly outperforms traditional models, such as LSTM, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), in predicting CPU and memory usage, as evaluated by metrics including Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and the Coefficient of Determination (R2).

articleTitle: EMO-Care: Emotional Interaction System Based on Multimodal Fusion and Edge Intelligence for Emotional Care
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In recent years, driven by the new generation of artificial intelligence technology, emotional computing has garnered significant attention and achieved substantial progress. Multimodal emotional computing based on technologies such as deep learning, computer vision, wearable computing, multimodal machine learning, and reinforcement learning has emerged as a research focus. Emotional computing research is shifting from the cognition of human emotions to a novel stage of emotional interaction. It becomes feasible to construct multimodal emotional interaction application systems with the ability of emotional care. This paper proposes a multimodal emotional care system based on wearable computing and reinforcement learning, introduces the overall architecture and core components of the system, and discusses the problems and solutions faced by the system, which has important value for how to build a dynamic, real-time and highly personalized emotional interaction application based on the user's current emotional state.

articleTitle: Design of Plateau Dispersion Oxygen Supply Control Device Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low oxygen concentration and poor oxygen comfort, a dispersive oxygen supply device based on STM32 controller is designed in this paper. The device is composed of central processor, data acquisition module, display module, communication module, control output module and power management module. The experimental results show that the modularity and precise control in the design of the device make it not only provide stable and reliable oxygen supply, but also adapt to different needs and environments and improve human comfort, so it can be used in hospitals and medical institutions, elderly care centers, first aid and disaster rescue. Compared with the traditional oxygen supply equipment, the device has the advantages of greater continuity, safety, stability and comfort, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: A High-Reliability Video Auto-Scaling Hardened Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Energetic particles impacting avionics video processing design systems in the radiation environment possibly produce single-event upsets, leading to partial dysfunction. To address this problem, this paper proposes a high-reliability video auto-scaling hardened design based on the Canny filter auto-scaling platform, using approximate truncation hardened design, Multi-Boot type RAM hardened design, approximate FIR RPR hardened design and incorporating edge information hardened design. Experiments in this paper demonstrate that compared to traditional hardened design and canny-scaling algorithm, this new hardened design has better applicability with an improved PSNR of 3.2992, a reduced BRAM of 33.5, and a reduced LUT of 9425.

articleTitle: Development and Accuracy Analysis of Domestic Intelligent Multi-channel Absolute Encoder Acquisition Device
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This article develops an intelligent multi-channel absolute encoder acquisition device (IMAEAD) for a domestically produced intelligent programmable logic controller (IPLC), using the GD32 microcontroller from GigaDevice Semiconductor as the MCU control unit. The SIT3088 from Xinlite receives the clock and data signals from the absolute encoder, and designs an upper computer based on the Rockchip CPU to achieve data exchange with the multi-channel encoder acquisition device through the CAN bus. The ASM58N-F1AK1R0GN-1213 encoder and SSI signal simulator were used in the experiment to verify and test the developed acquisition device. The developed device can achieve real-time acquisition of the encoded value and judge the upper or lower threshold limit. It has been applied in practical engineering. The factors affecting the measurement accuracy and real-time performance of the device is Analyzed and the software system is optimized. The developed device is designed based on domestically produced electronic components, ensuring the security of the chip supply chain.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Convolution Accelerator and Memristor IP Core for Cooperative Acceleration of the YOLO Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Object detection technology is widely used in areas such as autonomous driving, drone reconnaissance, smart surveillance and industrial automation, especially in remote or hazardous scenarios where it can improve efficiency and safety. Therefore, the development of a high-precision, low-power acceleration system integrated with low-power hardware is crucial. This paper proposes a collaborative acceleration scheme for the YOLO network based on an FPGA convolution accelerator and simulated memristors, which successfully implements and accelerates the YOLOv4-Tiny model. First, a reconfigurable single-core accelerator operator is designed for various computational operations in the model. Second, taking advantage of the digital device characteristics of memristors and the hardware resources of the FPGA, a memristor simulation IP core is built to exploit its memory characteristics for convolution operations. Through the synergistic effect of the convolution accelerator and the simulated IP core, a hybrid acceleration of the detection model is achieved. The power consumption of the convolution accelerator is only 2.75W, and in testing, the detection time for a single image is 823ms with an average accuracy of over 0.95, achieving high detection performance. This provides an opportunity to explore and research the efficient acceleration of object detection networks with integrated storage and computation.

articleTitle: ST-SNNCA: Spatio-Temporal Shared Nearest Neighbors Clustering Algorithm Based on Spatio-Temporal Neighbourhood Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the widespread use of mobile devices and GPS technology, the amount of trajectory data has been significantly accumulated. Therefore, how to properly analyze and mine these data has become an essential but challenging problem to be solved. Traditional trajectory clustering algorithms primarily focus on spatial similarity, disregarding the temporal relationship between different trajectories. To tackle this problem, a novel clustering algorithm called Spatio-temporal Shared Nearest Neighbors Clustering Algorithm is proposed in this work. By introducing temporal attributes during the trajectory segmentation stage, this algorithm effectively improves the reliability of segmentation points. Additionally, a Spatio-temporal Shared Nearest Neighbors method is developed by integrating temporal attributes with the Shared Nearest Neighbors approach, and it is found that this method can overcome the existing limitations of distance metrics by constructing the similarity matrix used for clustering. Finally, two different datasets of the hurricane track and animal track, respectively, are considered to verify the clustering validation of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Rainfall Prediction Based on LSTM and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In recent years, the strategic importance of local economic and social development, along with watershed development, has become increasingly prominent in the national economy. Accurate predictions of average precipitation at the local or watershed scale have become essential to provide a solid theoretical foundation for government agencies and reservoir management in flood control decision-making. This demand has raised the standards for rainfall forecasting. In this study, prediction models based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Random Forest are integrated. Initially, the LSTM model and Random Forest are utilized to generate the optimal rainfall prediction, followed by the Random Forest model being applied to estimate rainfall probability. The probabilistic rainfall output is then fused with the optimized prediction results to yield the final rainfall forecast.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multi-Device Wireless Power Transfer Systems: A Novel Decoupling Strategy with Bipolar Coils
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) technology provides key advantages over traditional charging methods, such as increased safety, convenience, and a broader charging range. However, single-receiver WPT systems lack resilience to transmitter coil failures and cannot simultaneously support multiple devices within the same charging area. Thus, the development of multi-load WPT systems is becoming increasingly urgent. A major challenge in multi-load WPT is cross-coupling, where unintended interactions between coils significantly reduce system efficiency and stability. Traditional methods to mitigate cross-coupling-such as adjusting coil placement, modifying coil shape, or adding complex compensation circuits-often involve intricate configurations that limit practical implementation or sacrifice efficiency. In contrast, this paper proposes a decoupling strategy using bipolar coils, offering a streamlined approach to suppress cross-coupling and enhance power stability in multi-load scenarios. Through this innovative solution, our study addresses limitations in current WPT systems, achieving improved reliability and output consistency without the complexity or efficiency trade-offs seen in traditional methods.

articleTitle: Universal Image Semantic Communication for Edge Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The increasing volume of data demands efficient communication systems for transmitting visual information across diverse application scenarios. Traditional methods based on Shannon's information theory overlook semantic content, leading to inefficient transmission of redundant data. Recent proposed deep learning-based semantic communication systems are often computationally intensive and domain-specific, limiting their practicality on edge devices and across various image types. We propose a universal image semantic communication (UISC) system - a lightweight, deep learning-based semantic communication framework for general-purpose image transmission. By processing low-frequency and high-frequency image components separately, our system reduces network complexity and enhances robustness to domain gaps. Unlike previous methods, UISC is versatile enough to handle RGB natural images, cartoons, text-embedded images, and grayscale medical images. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing methods in both transmission accuracy and latency while consuming significantly less computational resources.

articleTitle: An Extremely Low-Profile Patch Antenna Based on Epsilon-Near-Zero Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we utilize the novel electromagnetic characters of epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) materials to realize a extremely low-profile patch antenna. It employs an artificial material with ENZ equivalent dielectric permittivity to release the wave from a sub-wavelength structure into free space, thereby achieving a desired low-profile antenna. To clarify the mechanism of the proposed antenna, the simulated impedance characteristics and frequency response are studied. Simulated results show that the antenna has a low-profile geometry (4mm) and high radiating efficiency (S11 below −3 dB) at 2.6GHz. Unlike radiation performance in the traditional patch antenna, the radiation efficiency of the proposed antenna is barely related to the height. It will constrain the wave propagating along the direction of the slot on the patch antenna with infinite phase velocity and release it at extremely low height. Furthermore, a prototype is fabricated and measured. Both numerical simulations and measurement results indicate that the radiation performance improved with a much lower antenna height.

articleTitle: Simulation of Airborne Radar Sea Surface Scattering Based on Improved Sea Clutter Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Airborne radar plays an important role in sea surface search and rescue and national defense, and the analysis of control variables in multiple dimensions of the sea conditions of the sea surface to be detected, the frequency of the radar's electromagnetic wave, the altitude of the aircraft, and the angle of incidence is conducive to more intuitive simulation to simulate the most realistic sea surface detection environment. At the same time, the multi-dimensional consideration of the factors will also greatly improve the accuracy of the radar to detect the target. In this thesis, the backscattering characteristics of sea clutter will be explained and modeled, and the simulation of the improved model of sea clutter backscattering will provide new ideas for the analysis of sea surface scattering characteristics of airborne radar.

articleTitle: Intelligent Identification of Cracks in Wind Turbine Blades Based on Multiple Image Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The morphology of cracks in wind turbine blades is highly complex and irregular, with a significant level of complexity. Traditionally, the identification of cracks in wind turbine blades has mainly relied on manual operation, making it difficult to achieve automated classification of crack images. To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of crack identification in wind turbine blades, this study proposes an automatic recognition solution based on deep learning technology, aiming to efficiently and accurately identify cracks in wind turbine blades and reduce the workload of image preprocessing.

articleTitle: A Fast Three-Dimensional Imaging Algorithm for Millimeter Wave Radar Based on FiNUFFT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Millimeter wave radar is characterized by high penetration and low radiation, and its three-dimensional imaging capabilities enable the acquisition of richer target information. This has led to its widespread use in near-field three-dimensional imaging. Nevertheless, three-dimensional imaging necessitates the processing of a greater quantity of data, which in turn requires a higher computational efficiency. The interpolation operation involved in the commonly used frequency domain imaging algorithm is time-consuming and susceptible to interpolation errors, which ultimately degrades the imaging quality. This paper presents a fast three-dimensional imaging algorithm based on the Flatiron Institute Nonuniform fast Fourier transform (FiNUFFT). By substituting the traditional Stolt interpolation and subsequent fast Fourier transform (FFT) with FiNUFFT, the errors introduced by the interpolation operation are avoided and high-quality reconstruction is guaranteed with a notable increase in computational efficiency. A simulation experiment validates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: Flatiron Institute Nonuniform fast Fourier transform (FiNUFFT)

articleTitle: Edgraph: Dynamic GNN Inference with Multi-edge Clouds Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In edge computing (EC) scenarios such as traffic flow prediction and social relationship recommendations, the emerging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is the promising deep learning model to tackle these applications. However, since GNNs can cause a large amount of cross-server communication during their inference process, there is still a big challenge to provide cost-efficient intelligent services in EC for GNN processing. To address this issue, this paper proposes Edgraph, an efficient EC architecture for GNN computing, with the goal of minimizing the system's energy and time cost for processing user tasks. Specifically, at each time step, the architecture first perceives the user topology and represents their data association as a graph layout. Then the graph layout is optimized by calling our proposed hierarchical traversal graph cutting algorithm (HTGC). Finally, based on the optimized graph layout, our proposed deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based graph offloading algorithm (DRLGO) is executed to obtain the optimal offloading strategy for the tasks of users. Based on this strategy, the tasks of users are offloaded to edge servers and processed by the deployed GNN model. Experimental results show the effectiveness of our proposed architecture because it can fully learn dynamic scenario information and minimize the energy and time cost of the GNN-based EC system.

articleTitle: Research on Active ST Behavior Prediction of A-Share Listed Companies Based on RF-CRL Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The article focuses on revealing the behavior of A-share listed companies actively engaging in ST for malicious profit, and proposes an abnormal behavior prediction model based on RF-CRL algorithm. The article is based on the summary table of non compliant information of A-share listed companies in the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets from 2009 to 2024, and constructs a financial and non-financial indicator system for listed companies; From the perspectives of both long-term and short-term market effects, a labeling project for ST companies' proactive ST behavior has been designed. Based on historical data from the previous two years, convolutional pooling technology was used to extract features from ST company data, and LSTM was used to capture long-term potential dependencies between active ST company feature sequences. At the same time, a residual connection mechanism was introduced to integrate convolutional pooling with the input and output of LSTM, revealing deep data information within active ST companies and further enhancing the model's expressive power. The results show that the model can effectively predict the violations of active ST companies with an accuracy rate of 95.09%, which has positive practical significance for predicting the behavioral risks of A-share listed companies.

articleTitle: High Performance and Low Cost Hardware Implementation of FDIP on RISC-V
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In modern processors, instruction storage mostly adopts a multi-level caching mode, where the cache capacity is often limited due to various factors, such as area and cost. This limitation leads to cache miss during program execution frequently. However, RISC-V is currently underexplored in the field of high-performance computing. Instruction prefetch, which predicts the direction of program execution, fetches instructions in advance from lower-level storage, stores them into the I-Cache or a buffer for pipeline execution, thus reducing instruction fetch latency. This paper implements a hardware decoupled front-end architecture and fetch directed instruction prefetch (FDIP) on RISC-V to mitigate pipeline stalls caused by cache miss, thereby enhancing cpu performance. Additionally, FDIP enables the RISC-V cpu to approach the higher performance with smaller I-Cache capacity. Experimental results show that with I-Cache size at 128B, FDIP can achieve up to 11.7% performance improvement with area only increases by 6%, reducing the I-Cache miss rate by 6% as equal. By adopting various prefetch filter strategies, the effective prefetch rate can reach over 90%. Furthermore, when reducing I-Cache capacity by 75%, the cpu performance only decreases by 2%.

articleTitle: Design of Reinforcement Learning Environment with Time Sensitive Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Self-play theory is an important branch of reinforcement learning. Different levels of complexity in scenarios are also necessary to make reinforcement learning more sophisticated. In this paper, a new reinforcement learning scenario environment is designed. This scene is a game where the red and blue teams throw snowballs at each other to attack each other. In this scenario, it is more sensitive to time. The reward for the action depends on the influence of the snowball after a period of time, rather than immediate feedback. The IPPO and MAPPO algorithms are tested in this scenario. At the same time, we designed six different difficulty level rule strategies. This paper tested the trained model against six rules, counted the number of wins and losses between them, and provided the test results.

articleTitle: Multimodal Depression Recognition Based on Self-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Depression is a widespread and severe mental health disorder, characterized by a significant prevalence and a high incidence rate, which presents numerous challenges in diagnosis and treatment. We introduce an innovative multimodal approach for depression recognition utilizing self-supervised learning. The method analyzes audio and video data through three steps: extracting image features, extracting audio features, and performing multimodal temporal fusion, enabling an assessment of depression severity. Extensive experiments conducted on the AVEC2014 dataset demonstrate that the proposed model achieves a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 7.013 and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 8.616 in depression prediction tasks, showcasing strong performance.

articleTitle: Eco-Rail: Energy-Saving Strategies for Complex Terrain on the Chang-Ping Line
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of electrified transport systems, the problem of train energy consumption has become increasingly prominent. In this paper, an energy-saving optimisation strategy is proposed by analysing the four phases of train operation (towing, cruising, idling, and braking). The strategy employs nonlinear programming and bivariate variable step-size traversal methods to reduce energy consumption and improve computational efficiency by controlling the departure time and speed profile of the train. The model based on the section of the Beijing Metro Chang-ping Line from Xi'erqi to the Academy of Life Sciences, taking into account various operational demands and unexpected conditions. The shortest running time is determined to be 206.15 seconds, and the lowest energy consumption trajectory is optimised. The relationship curves between speed, traction braking force, time, energy consumption, and distance are plotted, demonstrating the strategy's effectiveness. Compared to previous studies, the proposed method significantly reduces energy consumption and improves real-time response capability, making it suitable for practical application in urban rail transit systems. The data-set is available at https://github.com/JiangYiLIEN/Enegrgy_Saving_Railway.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Music Emotion Recognition Method for Sound and Light Fusion Emotion Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In response to the needs of smart car cockpits, we proposed a sound-light fusion multi-sensory emotion regulation strategy for the driver's emotions, and carried out specific research on the problem of continuous mapping from music to dimensional emotional space. In order to solve the problem that the current music emotion recognition method does not meet the needs of sound-light emotion fusion, a hybrid network model Music-ESHN (Music Emotion Scale Hybrid Net, Music-ESHN) that integrates the multi-scale emotional features of music in time and space is proposed. The model consists of a local feature abstraction block(LFAB) and a global feature abstraction block(GFAB). The local feature abstraction block is used to capture the multi-scale emotional features of the spatial dimension, while the global feature abstraction block focuses on the contextual features of the temporal dimension. The two-part structure works synergistically to effectively improve the dynamic consistency of the music dynamic emotion recognition results and meet the needs of continuous mapping of emotions in sound-light emotion fusion.

articleTitle: SAGNet: A Dual-Branch Segmentation Model Based on Shape Priors and Boundary Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In recent years, remote sensing analysis has garnered significant attention in visual analysis applications, particularly in segmenting and recognizing remote sensing images. However, existing studies relying on deep convolutional neural network-based segmentation algorithms often fail to adequately address target boundary processing and lack attention to the distinctive shape characteristics of objects. To alleviate these issues, this paper introduces the SAGNet. SAGNet consists of two continuously integrating branches designed to maintain high resolution while enhancing the extraction of contextual features of the network. To integrate features from both branches, we develop a DISPP module. In addition, we propose an EdgeEnhanceRend module to refine object boundaries for enhanced delineation. Considering the shape characteristics of AGs, we incorporate a SA module within the dual-branch structure to integrate segmentation tasks with shape prior learning. This integration allows them to share and interact with potential high-level semantics and shape priors to achieve better segmentation results. Experimental results show that SAGNet significantly outperforms other methods in precise identification of AGs.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Study on Fusion of Spatio-Temporal Data Based on EST - ConvLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Depression has emerged as a significant public health concern globally, with diagnosis often hindered by subjective biases and a lack of objective assessment methods. This paper introduces a novel approach utilizing resting-state EEG data to facilitate the auxiliary diagnosis of depression through deep learning models. Initially, the EEG data from the MODMA public dataset at Lanzhou University were processed to extract clean signals, employing techniques such as Fourier Transform to delineate power spectra across key frequency bands-beta, theta, gamma. These spectra provided the basis for creating spatial brain maps, integrating both frequency and spatial data for enhanced diagnostic accuracy. Subsequently, a EST-ConvLSTM model were developed to analyze these brain maps, extracting temporal and spatial features essential for identifying depressive states. The models demonstrated robust performance, with the EST-ConvLSTM model achieving a classification accuracy of 74.66% on a public dataset, validated against established metrics including ROC curves and AUC values. The network had less complexity with only five layers. The findings underscore the potential of integrating EEG signals with advanced neural network architectures to improve the objectivity and efficacy of depression diagnostics, paving the way for more reliable and accessible mental health assessments.

articleTitle: Exponential Cluster Synchronization Under Fast Switching Network Topologies: Controllability, Connectivity, and Compactness
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This research investigates the intricate domain of synchronization problem among multiple agents operating within a dynamic network topology. A pivotal aspect of this paper aims to find the weakest possible conditions to make the coupled system realize cluster synchronization exponentially under fast switching topology framework. By introducing a new variable, the coupled error systems are transformed into controllable error system with perturbations. Then, we can find that the coupled system could achieve cluster synchronization if the system is controllable; the communication topology switches fast enough and the coupling strength is sufficiently robust. To investigate the necessary of above three conditions, several sufficient conditions are proved to ensure the coupled system achieve cluster synchronization under fast switching topology. Furthermore, this paper culminates in the incorporation of contraction theory and an invariant manifold, demonstrating that the switching topology has an average and state matrices are controllable, which are also imperative for achieving cluster synchronization. Finally, we introduce three simulations to validate the efficacy of the proposed approach and theory.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Graph Infomax Model Combined with Convolutional Neural Network for Acupoint Compatibility Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The strategic selection and compatibility of acupoints are fundamental guiding principles within the domain of acupuncture and moxibustion, which provide valuable insights for medical practitioners in determining optimal treatment. Notably, discerning patterns concerning the compatibility of acupoints emerges as a promising avenue to enhance therapeutic efficacy in the treatment of various ailments. However, sparse acupuncture data tend to pose significant challenge on existing methodologies. In response to this challenge, we propose an enhanced graph infomax model combined with Convolutional Knowledge-base (EGICK). EGICK leverages the Deep Graph Infomax (DGI) embedding model to derive embeddings for entities and relations, thereby facilitating enhanced interactions between these elements. Concurrently, it harnesses the advantages of contrastive learning to mitigate the adverse effects of data sparsity. Specifically, our model exhibits the capacity to comprehensively acquire acupoint compatibility rules by amalgamating both structural and semantic information pertaining to entities and their relations. Subsequently, we construct an acupuncture knowledge graph to verify the effectiveness of the model, utilizing a corpus of acupuncture literature. Furthermore, Empirical experimentation demonstrates the superior performance of EGICK comparison to other models, as substantiated across publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Detection of All Dynamic Objects in Neural SLAM with Local Voxel Map
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Recent Visual SLAM research focus on scenes that are static, where minimal changes are assumed. However, these scenarios do not consistently align with the dynamic nature frequently encountered in real-world environments. We present LVM-SLAM, a dense neural visual SLAM, which employs geometry constraints to build the local voxel map and detect all dynamic objects. The implemented local voxel map is low-cost and efficient for filtering out dynamic points. Our system can accurately track in highly dynamic situations with numerous moving targets, and remove dynamic targets during the 3D scene reconstruction process. We evaluate our system on TUM RGB-D and Bonn Dynamic RGB-D datasets. Experimental results reveal that our system not only improves the tracking accuracy, but also enhances the real-time performance without the necessity for introducing a segmentation network.

articleTitle: Research on the Clustering Method of Power user Portrait based on RFM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduce a novel approach to constructing electricity customer profiles by augmenting the RFM model with various additional factors, including electricity consumption categories, industry types, average monthly consumption volumes, and electricity costs. Subsequently, we employ both K-means and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) clustering algorithms to segment and analyze user data, comparing their respective performances. Through experimental validation utilizing FM and Adjusted-Rand indices, we assess the clustering outcomes. The results demonstrate that the GMM algorithm surpasses K-means in classification performance, thereby confirming the feasibility and efficacy of our proposed methodology. This work offers pivotal insights for precision marketing strategies and service optimization within the electric power industry.

articleTitle: Review of Radio Frequency Fingerprint Technology Applied in Satellite Security Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Satellites are becoming more and more crucial in civilian and military fields. However, the openness of satellite communication link makes it susceptible to electronic reconnaissance and attacks, posing security issues such as identity impersonation and deception. For the sake of satellite communication safety, radio frequency fingerprinting technology has been proposed as an effective means. This technology leverages the subtle differences produced by wireless communication devices during the manufacturing process to form unique signal “fingerprint” characteristics, thereby identifying specific transmitters. This paper reviews the research of radio frequency fingerprinting technology applied in satellite security protection, as well as the application of deep learning and radio frequency fingerprints in satellite security protection. In particular, we introduce representative works on radio frequency fingerprinting technology in combating deception and replay attacks, and analyze the resilience of satellite fingerprint identification systems against jamming attacks, as well as provide a method for identifying the identity of satellite control ground stations based on radio frequency fingerprints. Furthermore, the paper discusses the challenges faced by radio frequency fingerprinting technology applied in satellite security and future research directions, providing new technical means and theoretical references for improving the security of satellite communication links.

articleTitle: HOI-Based Method for Detecting Cell Phone Behavior in Industrial Safety Production Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the practical problems of algorithm inference timeliness and the complex environment in industrial settings, The presented dissertation introduces a comprehensive human-object interaction recognition technique, leveraging the attention-based architecture of the Transformer model. By sampling key features at different scales from the industrial complex environment and using Transformer's attention mechanism to aggregate global information, the algorithm achieves accurate detection of targets in complex environments while eliminating post-processing processes such as non-maximal value suppression to achieve real-time detection. Moreover, a deformable attention module is used to optimize small target detection and the multi-headed attention mechanism of Transformer, which adaptively adjusts the position and shape of the feature extraction window, reducing the computational effort of the attention computation process and accelerating the model training time. The investigation outcomes reveal that the introduced HOI-centric technique for identifying mobile phone infractions within industrial safety contexts exhibits superior accuracy in detection and notable enhancements in computational efficiency when benchmarked against other sophisticated algorithms in the expanded mobile phone category within the HICO-DET dataset.

articleTitle: Twin UAVs-Assisted Wireless Relay Secure Transmission with Imperfect Eavesdropper CSI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Due to the broadcasting nature, wireless transmission becomes vulnerable to illegal eavesdropping, making it crucial to ensure the security of data transmission for various IoT applications. This paper investigates UAV-assisted wireless relay secure transmission, considering multiple eavesdroppers with imperfect channel state information (CSI). The goal is to maximize the secure transmission capacity of users through the cooperation of signal UAVs and jamming UAVs. Under imperfect eavesdropper CSI conditions, an adaptive decoding threshold is introduced to restrict the eavesdropping decoding probability below a tolerable level. The secure transmission problem is modeled as a mixed-integer nonlinear programming. An iteration algorithm that combines block coordinate descent and continuous convex approximation is designed to jointly optimize UAV trajectory planning and resource allocation. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

Index Terms: Channel State Information Of The Eavesdropper

articleTitle: Incremental Learning for Remote Sensing Image Detection Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Deep learning techniques have been widely applied to remote sensing image detection tasks. This paper proposes an improved method based on YOLOv5, named CI-YOLOv5 (Class Increment YOLOv5), which aims to achieve incremental learning for remote sensing images. CI-YOLOv5 incorporates the Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) and the Scale-agnostic Channel Attention Module (SimAM) to enhance its ability to extract aircraft-related features. During the incremental learning phase, the model is adjusted using a knowledge distillation-based approach and loss function optimization to learn the features of new category samples. This approach effectively addresses the issue of catastrophic forgetting, ensuring that the model maintains accurate retention of previously acquired knowledge when exposed to new data.

articleTitle: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Dynamic Graph Modeling for Robust EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) signals contain valuable bioinformation, capturing emotion-related brain activity and enabling machines to interpret human behavior for improved human-computer interaction. EEG-based emotion recognition models face three main challenges: EEG noise and individual differences, limited spatiotemporal dynamics, and unclear classification boundaries during emotional state transition. To address these, we propose NODEs-STDGCN, a spatiotemporal dynamic graph convolutional network with parameter uncertainty and an end-to-end training paradigm based on Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C). NODEs-STDGCN combines an autoregressive model (AR) with neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) to reduce information loss from discretization: AR captures long-term dependencies, while NODEs local spatiotemporal dynamics. Final features are fed into an MLP and SoftMax for classification. Here, each parameter follows a 2D Gaussian distribution, allowing for adaptively selecting weight configuration for each instance. The A2C-based training paradigm further contributes to balance multiple task requirements by guiding gradient updates during backpropagation. Extensive experiments on the SEED dataset demonstrates that A2C-based training paradigm, uncertainty in parameters, and effective model architecture enable NODEs-STDGCN to outperform state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, the A2C-based training offers a promising approach to improving EEG-based emotion recognition in complex conditions.

articleTitle: Status Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis of Cigarette Machine Feeding System Method Study
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time monitoring of the status of the cigarette machine feeding system and automatic diagnosis of faults, a method for monitoring and diagnosing the status of the cigarette machine feeding system based on multi-sensor application and machine learning is proposed. The time-frequency characteristics of the suction pipe negative pressure data are extracted through wavelet packet analysis, and the average and standard deviation of the suction pipe negative pressure data are used as feature vector inputs. The performance of convolutional neural network and support vector machine in fault classification and recognition is compared. The experimental results show that the state recognition method based on support vector machine (linear kernel) can effectively diagnose faults in the cigarette machine feeding system, laying a theoretical foundation and technical support for the online monitoring and fault diagnosis of the cigarette machine feeding system.

articleTitle: Tibetan Medicine Intelligent Consultation System Based on Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the widespread application of artificial intelligence technology, the medical informatization has entered a new stage. Although intelligent question-answering systems have achieved a certain extent of promotion and landing in various consulting fields, the Tibetan medicine field is still blank. This article designs an intelligent consultation system for Tibetan medicine knowledge and uses a graph database to store data, displaying the content of the graph database in the form of a dynamic web page for users. This is beneficial for the further promotion and dissemination of Tibetan medicine culture.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice Path of Workers in Rural Construction Industry Promoted by the Construction of AI-Based Digital Sharing Training Base
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
